comparison.objective: Reinstall and lock a dishwasher's lower and upper filters; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Slide a flat filter under tabs, coaxially drop a cylindrical filter, and quarter-turn its lugs versus long-part leveling, spring-prong insertion at two posts, telescoping, and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires lower-filter registration and upper-filter detent lock; candidate requires correct side, four intended rack holes at one unit, spring return, bottom screws, and released support.
comparison.reason: Tab engagement and locking are generic; the dishwasher task does not test distributed load-bearing rail installation.
